hooks.name: Update STATUS before stopping
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to keep docs/STATUS.md and tasks.md in sync at the end of a run.

action.prompt: If this run changed code or completed spec tasks: make sure the completed tasks are checked in the spec's tasks.md, docs/STATUS.md reflects what was done and what is next, and `pnpm check` passed. If any of that is missing, do it now. If the run changed nothing, do nothing.
